summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by InterContinental Hotels Group PLC reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on 7 May 2026. All 12 resolutions were passed, including routine items such as adoption of reports, director elections, auditor reappointment, and share authorities. There is no special situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. The only management update is a routine committee assignment following a prior resignation.
